owner_requirements.archival: retain_existing_private_drive_audio; no delete/no regenerate/no R2/no public GitHub audio

story_dialogue_turns.note: Reader section male-only includes characters and dialogue, unless owner later changes policy.

guided_current_word.next_word_rule: advance after acceptable recognition or explicit assisted path; not automatically mastered

reading.alignment: real timestamps from approved audio, never fabricated word timing

lessons.dialogue_voice_policy: Assign male and female voices to natural distinct roles within a dialogue; preserve one voice per role across turns. Do not require both genders on every isolated utterance.

dictionary.lexical_coverage: Every Czech word FORM displayed in PUBLISHED lessons, stories, or dictionary reading views must resolve to one suitable, individually playable audio unit.
dictionary.link_chain: lesson/story token → form_id → lexeme_id + sense_id(context) → approved word audio asset
dictionary.lexeme_policy: voda and vodu share one lemma entry, but each distinct spoken inflected FORM needs its own correct pronunciation asset. Sense IDs and forms must not be conflated.
dictionary.homographs: Do not collapse genuinely different pronunciations to one audio even when spelling matches; dialect/accent and register need explicit metadata.
dictionary.lookup_audio_scope: Word player plays single selected form; it must never play whole sentence/narration as a word recording.
dictionary.reuse_condition: Reuse if all key fields match and audio/content quality is independently approved; otherwise keep archived and do not auto-reuse.

legacy_archive.notes: The 276 private MP3s are NOT 276 verified dictionary word assets. Most are phrases/sentences. Preserve original record/voice/hash and exact Czech text in private manifest. Do not leak private file IDs or metadata into public app or repo.

audio_asset_contract.storage_ref_private: server-side or private manifest only; never public client
audio_asset_contract.dedupe: Do not conflate same source text with different voice, form, style, speed, audio type or revision.
audio_asset_contract.text_change: Exact canonical spoken text or revision change invalidates active mapping; archive unchanged; new audio only after editorial approval.
audio_asset_contract.fallback_rule: Missing word audio is MISSING/BLOCKED; do not fabricate playback success or use nonconsensual on-demand TTS.
audio_asset_contract.deployment: No public R2/CDN/GitHub media until separately approved by owner.

module_dependencies.lexicon_master: one lexeme source Top100→200→300→500→1000, stable lexeme/sense/form IDs; vocabulary stages cumulative, no duplicate lemmas
module_dependencies.dictionary: surface token lookup uses lexeme sense in context, not English/other language default sense
module_dependencies.learning_content: reuse word audio via stable form references and approved manifest; not independent word renders
module_dependencies.graded_reader: male only; all displayed tokens link to single-word playback as requested
module_dependencies.QA: aggregate coverage counts PUBLISHED content only; source A0 outlines are draft and not included as published lesson coverage
